mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.song_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.create_time, u.name AS username, u.avatar AS avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.song_id = #{songId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (song_id, user_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{songId}, #{userId}, #{content}, NOW())
INSERT INTO comment (poem_id, user_id, parent_id, content, create_time) VALUES (#{poemId}, #{userId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.song_id, c.poem_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.create_time, u.name AS username, u.avatar AS avatar, c.parent_id AS parentId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like l WHERE l.comment_id = c.id AND l.user_id = #{viewerId}) > 0 AS likedByMe, (SELECT ru.name FROM comment rc JOIN `user` ru ON ru.id = rc.user_id WHERE rc.id = c.parent_id) AS replyTo FROM comment c LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.poem_id = #{poemId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_like WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO comment_like (comment_id, user_id) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comment_like WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.poem_id, c.content, c.create_time, m.title AS poem_title FROM comment c JOIN poem m ON m.id = c.poem_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comment WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, poem_id AS poemId, user_id AS userId, parent_id AS parentId, content FROM comment WHERE id = #{id}
